append.detail: FOLLOW-UP 2026-10-12 (2). The inbound bridge's member-facing Reply-To addresses (the legacy forward-and-send in routeHouseReplyOutbound and the atomic payload) now come from buildSpaceConversationReplyAddress, so a Space thread carries the Space alias on every member-facing send. The HOUSE address the operator replies to from their own inbox stays a Frequency-signed token on purpose: aliases carry the member role only, and the house route is what authenticates the operator. Send-path coverage is complete; the integrated pilot, owner revocation and retention remain.
